notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.0.1 - Release Notes
===================================================================

- New Feature: Day Select. After completing the game, you will have the option to select any day from the title screen. Selecting a day will clear any progress on the current day, but your treasure will be kept. Some events, such as look at photo targets will also reset.
- Fixed mouse cursor appearing on-screen during certain alert messages where a button press is required instead.
- Added ability to use W and S keys and the mouse scroll wheel to navigate through dialogue options.
- Adjusted how grass is removed when digging.
- Added safeguards to address the endless vibration bug.
- Increased default music volume.
- Fixed missing sound fx on Day + 

Known Issues and troubleshooting
